findings.evidence: Report accuracy, second occurrence of the same habit. The completion summary states 'the 81 unrelated FAILs are all pre-existing AuthSheet issues'; 80 are, one is Mantine/Primitives/PasswordInput/Default x en x mobile-390 with a different failure signature. The session log does disclose the 80->81 delta but does not name the story and folds it into the AuthSheet class, and asserts 'not attributable to this diff' without the concrete counter-check docs/agent-contract.md requires for a causal claim. AC-R11 said pre-existing failures must be identified by story name, not aggregated. The reviewer ran the counter-check and found no regression, so the substance holds and no AC outcome changes; the reporting rigor does not. Same shape as the Task 762 submission's own 'all 80 FAIL + 27 AMBIGUOUS are AuthSheet' compression, where the 27 were four other stories.

Accepted variance, authorized here by the reviewer rather than passed silently. AC-R6 required zero delta on the whole computed string. Seven cells differ: three box-shadow values lost their leading fully-transparent 0 0 0 0 layers (MobileBottomNavView .navBar and .fab in two states, ListingCard .overlayFavorite) and four transitionProperty values lost --tw-gradient-from/via/to. Both classes are rendered-inert and the session log enumerates every cell in a per-element before/after table rather than narrating them away. The reviewer checked the one mechanism by which a dropped transparent layer would not be inert - box-shadow interpolation during a transition - and confirmed no changed element transitions box-shadow. Recorded so that 'zero delta' is not carried forward as the literal outcome of this revision.

MantineHomeSection.module.css and PopularLocationsView.module.css are unmodified. The revision brief's R5 named them for a comment update where the text no longer describes what the file does. Their comments describe the Tailwind composition each file reproduces, which is still accurate, so no change was needed - but the report should have said so explicitly rather than leaving two named files silently absent from the diff.
